column1: # The data build of Clueless-Norm's SFT corpus, one line, consumed by configs/control_pretraining/build_corpora.sh and
# checked by configs/control_pretraining/verify_corpora.py against the same line. Columns, in order (semantics in
#   subset | stage | kind | config | prep_h | tok_h | workers | partitions | shards | shard_mode | stripe | docs
# The row is the quality-filtered xl-50b corpus's (../../control_pretraining/30b_baseline_ablations/corpora.tsv, the
# corpus the v4 SFT trains on) with only the subset, the prepare config and the document count changed, so the two
# packs are built by the same chain at the same geometry: a byte-gated split into 32 shards, each packed in its own job.
# The prepare config reads its commit from the revision file the push's manifest job writes, and checks the files
# against that job's manifest, when the prepare runs; the build is queued behind that job (build_corpora.sh's
# BUILD_AFTER). docs stays PENDING until the corpus's row count is known: plan_corpus refuses a PENDING row.
